Read more about the different categories of elevated expression {{4}}.

templates.pat: Yes, please see {{1}} for full details.

We update the Human Protein Atlas regularly based on careful curation of the data. Curation involves, among other things, removal of data/antibody/images which do not meet our quality criteria. When possible we replace data/antibody/images with more recent improved versions.{{1}}{{2}}Please visit {{3}} to find out in which version the antibody of your interest was removed or old images were replaced with more recent ones. You can access previous versions of the Human Protein Atlas by typing vX.proteinatlas.org in your web browser and replace X with the version relevant for you.
templates.zh: 我们依据对数据的仔细审校定期更新人类蛋白质图谱。审校包括移除不符合我们质量标准的数据／抗体／图像等。条件允许时，我们会用更新的改进版本替换数据／抗体／图像。{{1}}{{2}}请访问{{3}}，查看你关注的抗体是在哪个版本中被移除的，或旧图像在哪个版本中被替换为新图像。你可以在浏览器中输入 vX.proteinatlas.org（把 X 换成所需的版本号）访问人类蛋白质图谱的旧版本。

templates.pat: The guidelines for the reliability scores are specific for each sub-atlas. You can read more about the guidelines for the Tissue Atlas {{1}} and the Cell Atlas {{2}}. The reliability score is based on consistency with internal RNA-seq data, support from external sources (UniprotKB/Swiss-Prot), as well as staining pattern similarity between independent antibodies.
templates.zh: 可靠性评分指南因各子图谱而异。有关组织图谱指南的更多内容请见{{1}}，细胞图谱请见{{2}}。可靠性评分依据与内部 RNA-seq 数据的一致性、外部来源（UniprotKB/Swiss-Prot）的支持，以及不同独立抗体间染色模式的相似性。

templates.pat: Protein expression score is based on immunohistochemical data manually scored with regard to staining intensity (negative, weak, moderate or strong) and fraction of stained cells (<25%, 25-75% or >75%). Each combination of intensity and fractions is automatically converted into an protein expression level score as follows: negative - not detected; weak <25% - not detected; weak combined with either 25 - 75% or 75% - low; moderate <25% - low; moderate combined with either 25 - 75% or 75% - medium; strong <25% - medium, strong combined with either 25 - 75% or 75% - high. In addition to this, protein expression values are manually adjusted as necessary when evaluated by our expert annotators. More information about knowledge-based annotation is available in the {{1}}.{{2}}{{3}}An comprehensive summary of immunohistochemical primary data is available for each gene on the “Primary data page”, e.g. {{4}}
templates.zh: 蛋白质表达评分依据免疫组化数据，由人工按染色强度（阴性、弱、中等或强）与染色细胞比例（小于 25%、25-75% 或大于 75%）评分。各强度与比例的组会自动换算为蛋白质表达水平评分：阴性 - 未检出；弱且小于 25% - 未检出；弱且 25-75% 或 75% - 低；中等且小于 25% - 低；中等且 25-75% 或 75% - 中；强且小于 25% - 中，强且 25-75% 或 75% - 高。此外，经我们的专家注释员评估后，蛋白质表达值会按需人工调整。关于基于知识的注释的更多信息请见{{1}}。{{2}}{{3}}每个基因的免疫组化原始数据汇总见「原始数据页」，例如 {{4}}

templates.pat: The images on the atlas are the raw data that show the immunohistochemical staining of each antibody. The expression score describes a knowledge-based best estimate of the true protein expression. This means that an expert has manually analyzed all images and assessed if the staining is likely to be the true protein expression or not. If the expert determined that the staining seen is not the true protein expression, the score will be set to "not detected". {{1}}{{2}}More information about annotation of antibody staining is available in the {{3}}. {{4}}{{5}}More information about knowledge-based annotation of protein expression is available in the {{6}}.
templates.zh: 图谱中的图像是展示各抗体免疫组化染色的原始数据。表达评分是基于知识的、对真实蛋白质表达的最佳估计。这意味着由专家人工分析全部图像，并判断染色是否可能代表真实的蛋白质表达。若专家判定所见染色并非真实的蛋白质表达，评分将设为「未检出」。{{1}}{{2}}关于抗体染色注释的更多信息请见{{3}}。{{4}}{{5}}关于基于知识的蛋白质表达注释的更多信息请见{{6}}。

templates.pat: The Kaplan-Meier plot shows the probability of survival at different time-points e.g. the probability of surviving 5 years while having the disease. The plot describes that at the start, i.e. at time-point zero, 100% of patients were alive. Over time, with each death, the number of patients alive decreases, which leads to a drop in the curve. This in turn means that with each death the probability of survival for remaining patients decreases. So, those patients who have lived 10 years have lower probability of survival than those who have lived 5 years. In order to see if the expression of a certain gene affects the survival rate, the patient material has been divided into two groups, with high or low expression. If a gene is unfavourable, the group with highest expression will have lower survival rate, i.e. the curve will drop earlier. For more information about Kaplan-Meier plots, including how probability is calculated, we would recommend this {{1}}
templates.zh: Kaplan-Meier 曲线展示不同时间点的生存概率，例如患病后存活 5 年的概率。曲线表明，起点（即时间点 0）时 100% 的患者均存活。随着时间推移，每出现一例死亡，存活患者数就减少，曲线随之下移。这也意味着每出现一例死亡，剩余患者的生存概率都会下降。因此，已存活 10 年的患者，其生存概率低于已存活 5 年的患者。为判断某基因的表达是否影响生存率，患者材料被分为高表达与低表达两组。若某基因不利，则高表达组的生存率更低，即曲线下降更早。关于 Kaplan-Meier 曲线（包括概率如何计算）的更多信息，我们推荐阅读这篇{{1}}
